title: Storm balcony and loose-object control
summary: Reduce windborne debris and blocked-drain hazards before strong wind and rain arrive.
steps: From safe conditions, secure or bring in loose items, keep exits and drains clear, close vulnerable openings, and stop exterior work when wind, lightning, or surfaces become unsafe.

title: Lightning activity boundary
summary: Suspend exposed outdoor work and water-related activity when thunder or official lightning warnings indicate danger.
steps: Move to a substantial building or enclosed vehicle, avoid isolated trees, ridges, metal fences, open water, and wired or plumbing contact until conditions are cleared.
